precision.note: Root precision is numerical convergence, not absolute timing accuracy; near stations timing is less certain.

report.predictive_validity: Traditional symbolic interpretation; no calibrated probability or demonstrated personal-event accuracy.
limitations: Fixed natal positions and angles; no progressed targets.
Sampled stations are refined; multiple unseen reversals in a three-hour scan cell may be missed.
Exact times are astronomical contacts, not promises of life events.

presentation.duration_convention: Brief means less than 24 calculated hours within the selected orb and window; multi-day means at least 24. These are display bins, not significance judgments.

precision.note: Root precision is numerical convergence, not absolute timing accuracy; near stations timing is less certain.

report.predictive_validity: Traditional symbolic interpretation; no calibrated probability or demonstrated personal-event accuracy.
limitations: Fixed natal positions and angles; no progressed targets.
Sampled stations are refined; multiple unseen reversals in a three-hour scan cell may be missed.
Exact times are astronomical contacts, not promises of life events.

presentation.duration_convention: Brief means less than 24 calculated hours within the selected orb and window; multi-day means at least 24. These are display bins, not significance judgments.

phase_context.meaning: Applying approaches exactness; separating recedes. A station can interrupt application.

grouping_source.locator: Discussion of duration, retrograde repetitions and stations
grouping_source.principle: A transit can describe a sequence across a period, not only a single instant. Duration here is computed from the chosen orb.

result.sampling: One native ephemeris sample per day at the window’s UTC clock time; exact contacts use native root times, without interpolation.

turning_recording.scope: Actual native 30-day transit calculation over synthetic QA natal moment. Live UI, no mocked results or compositing. Only initial input/computation setup trimmed; no soundtrack.

events.action: A repeated pass inside the same window

conventions.coordinates: apparent geocentric true ecliptic/equinox of date; outer planets use system barycenters
conventions.time: IANA tzdata 2025.2; Skyfield builtin leap seconds and modeled delta T

limitations: UT1 uses bundled delta-T model; historical time-zone records and birth times may be uncertain.
Quadrant systems reject the polar domain explicitly; assignments use ecliptic longitude sectors, not mundane latitude.

conventions.core: Reduce date components/name parts separately, retaining11/22/33 at every core reduction stage. Keep original totals and digit-sum steps.
conventions.birthday: Retain actual day1–31 as Birthday number; show reduced/master companion separately, never replace original day.
conventions.cycles: Calendar Jan1 year transition; reduce cycles to1–9 without masters. Use sequential Sun/birth-month-day → year → month → day method from daily guide; compounds belong to that method, not aggregate formula.
conventions.name_policy: Explicit birth/current basis. ASCII A–Z case-insensitive only; ASCII space separates name parts. Hyphen/apostrophe join letters inside a part and are recorded as zero-value separators. This token policy is an explicit implementation convention, not claimed universal Decoz doctrine. Reject other characters/diacritics rather than transliterate. Every Y occurrence requires caller-specified vowel/consonant role, ordered left-to-right. No vowels/consonants in entire name yields unsupported null for that number.

conventions.coordinates: apparent geocentric true ecliptic/equinox of date; outer planets use system barycenters

limitations: UT1 uses bundled delta-T model; historical time-zone records and birth times may be uncertain.
Quadrant systems reject the polar domain explicitly; assignments use ecliptic longitude sectors, not mundane latitude.

execution_note: Complete 36-group browser gate runs separately from inherited CLI work, video and performance profiling. All original oracle, Codex and motion checks retained; six new Turning Sky groups cover native data, source depth, storage, cancellation, responsive/reduced motion and mobile labels/short comparison. Final stills settle motion only for capture; recording remains live.
acceptance_criteria: Native result equals replay through unchanged future.tarot.read
One/three cards, reversals and source references preserved
Progressive reveal and skip path; duplicates blocked and retry seed retained
No automatic cloud transmission; chapter persistence requires explicit Save to this device
Pixi renders without console errors, animates, and stops on pause/reduced motion
Complete journeys and export in mobile browser; accessibility scans and keyboard dialog pass
Small/tablet/desktop and doubled-text control geometry checks pass
No-WebGL fallback completes a native reading
Existing native/Workbench tests, full CLI/verifier gates, production builds and inventory/dependency gates pass
All 54 retained inventory IDs, six exclusions and availability categories match frozen projection
Real native Numerology parity, independent arithmetic, explicit Y/name basis and unsupported context preserved
Complete three-seal ritual, immediate reading path, exact export, retry/duplicate guards and session-only continuity
Numerology live material transforms, keyboard touch, reduced motion and low-power pause checks
Separate signed Numerology consent; provider prompt excludes names and dates; no automatic cloud transmission or original-input storage
Native transit report and all daily ephemeris samples independently replay for 1/7/30-day bounded API windows
Signed current natal basis excludes raw birth inputs; altered/expired/restarted proofs cannot reconstruct missing birth information
One killable worker, no queue; strict bounds, hard timeout, disconnect termination and slot cleanup tested
Saved dated edition preserves native exact timestamps, longitudes, matched rules, phase samples and native interval hours without new API calls
Mobile natal labels resolve collisions while longitude markers stay unchanged; compact comparison retains all citations on demand
Native Western chart and source composition equal direct unchanged engine replay
Exact live SVG planet longitudes, twelve house cusps and aspects match native results
Unknown time blocked; DST gaps, explicit folds, IANA historical offsets and polar restrictions tested
Explicit chart snapshot excludes raw birth datetime, coordinates, timezone, place, receipt and commentary
Frozen Western source edition restores source components without chart/provider POSTs
Gemini requires signed per-chart consent and omits original birth inputs from provider prompt
Responsive 320/390/768/1440 chart, keyboard turn, pause/reduced/low-capability and source depth pass
Explicit local save excludes raw birth/name/question inputs, Numerology target dates, traces, replay seeds and Gemini commentary; dated transit windows require explicit save
Frozen source edition reopens minimal chapters after refresh without new engine/provider POST requests
Unknown/corrupt/private-extra-key records fail closed; quota failures never fabricate saved status
Individual/all deletion preserves unrelated storage; other tabs refresh without stale chapter content
Real cover/leaf, source chapter navigation, keyboard/reduced motion and bounded responsive folios pass
Source-language comparison cites original themes, keeps alternatives separate and invents no agreement score or combined prediction
limitations: Local Chromium mobile/desktop emulation and software WebGL only; no physical iOS/Android, field CWV or actual INP certification
60 Hz is a target; sustained missed budgets reduce resolution and can select a 30 Hz low-power mode
No public deployment, distributed limiter, accounts or cloud sync; local chapters require explicit saving
Complete verified historical Archive Edition; a fully bespoke figurative FATE deck remains future artwork, never mixed into draws as placeholders
Gemini semantic faithfulness is not guaranteed
Software acceptance is not empirical prediction validation
Numerology direct themes cover Expression and Personal Year only; other numbers are context, never assigned unsupported meanings
Gallery upcoming status describes consumer availability only; no new engine or launch commitment
Numerology RAF cadence is main-thread scheduling evidence, not hardware compositor FPS; live provider semantic quality remains unverified
Daily sky samples are discrete at the chosen UTC clock time; exact focus shows only the actual contact geometry, without interpolated ephemeris positions
Natal origin proof lasts one hour and ends on process-key restart; saved chapters cannot restart live searches or recover birth inputs
Transit computation is bounded to 60 seconds and one active worker per process; long chapters may fill the 64K local document before the chapter-count cap
City points are approximate current GeoNames references; exact birthplace coordinates and historical timezone/birth-record accuracy need visitor verification
Western consumer room supports tropical modern natal components only; no unknown birth times, direct combined placement/planet-pair readings or event predictions
Derived saved chart geometry can reveal birth-moment information; size cap may bind before 50 chapters
Local records are unencrypted, editable and subject to browser clearing/quota/origin policies; no accounts, sync, automatic backup or import UI
Simultaneous cross-tab writes can conflict; explicit exports are the independent backup
Source-language comparison uses a bounded editorial vocabulary; lexical echoes are not independent corroboration
App/artwork must be available to reopen chapters; normal asset requests still reach the host
